intent_record.intent_summary: Fixes ROC abort synchronization logic by adding early return guard and ensuring interface resume iteration executes unconditionally after state clearance.
intent_record.what: Added early return guard checking MT76_STATE_ROC bit before timer deletion and work cancellation. Changed cancel_work_sync to cancel_work. Moved ieee80211_iterate_interfaces call outside the conditional block to execute unconditionally after the state check.
intent_record.how: Prevents unnecessary cleanup operations when ROC state is not active by returning early. Changes work cancellation from synchronous to asynchronous execution. Ensures interface resume iteration always occurs after clearing the ROC state flag, avoiding missed cleanup when the bit was already cleared.
